sections.heading: New
items: New keyframe UI: Keyframe edit has moved to the timeline editor! Expand the keyframe editor from the track header, and start editing keyframes directly below the clips.
Timeline markers: You can now leave markers and comments and agent will see them automatically. Use M to add one at playhead, option+drag to split the marker to a range.
Blur and text keyframes: We have more keyframe controls on videos and text.
